@title TronEscrowDeal — buyer-funded escrow on Tron TVM (TRC-20)
 @dev Mirrors Scroll EscrowDeal flow; deployed directly (no clone proxy) for TVM tooling compatibility.
@notice Trade amount returned to the buyer. The creation fee is never included.

@notice Seller cancel closes the trade and returns only the trade amount.
 The creation fee was already paid to the protocol at funding and is never refunded.
